snippet.title: Lancer Tactics KS trailer | be gay // do giant robot crimes
snippet.description:
It's finally happening! We're doing it! A Lancer video game!

LANCER TACTICS is a third-party adaptation of the tabletop ruleset to a tactics video game. It started as a small demo for me to learn Godot, but has now spiraled out and is on track to be developed into a full Lancer game engine.

The demo is playable at:
wick.itch.io/lancer-tactics

The Kickstarter got over 300% in just three days:
www.kickstarter.com/projects/wickworks/lancer-tactics

-----------

Reckless by Olivaw — soundcloud.com/olivaw
Creative Commons — Attribution 3.0 Unported — CC BY 3.0 
Music provided by Music for Creators • Reckless — Olivaw  

Lancer Tactics is not an official Lancer product; it is a third party work, and is not affiliated with Massif Press. Lancer Tactics is published via the Lancer Third Party License. Lancer is copyright Massif Press
